day_shape: 61 items: 26-nation joint statement on Strait of Hormuz multinational mission, fresh ship seizure near Fujairah diverted to Iranian waters, Araghchi at BRICS New Delhi clashing with UAE, UK FCDO refresh of Iran sanctions list, heavy Defa Press/IRIB cycle marking 40 days since Mousavi.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and coalition
threads.summary: The UK MoD published a 26-country joint statement on the Multinational Military Mission for the Strait of Hormuz dated 12 May, while UKMTO reported a ship seized near Fujairah and moved toward Iranian waters. Defa Press said Chinese vessels were permitted to transit under Iran's protocol, and the judiciary spokesman defended tanker seizures under UNCLOS; an Iranian lawmaker proposed annual fees on fibre-optic cables crossing Hormuz.

threads.label: Araghchi at BRICS New Delhi
threads.summary: Iran International reported Foreign Minister Araghchi accused the UAE of direct involvement in military operations against Iran at the BRICS foreign ministers meeting, and sought to rally the bloc against US and Israeli action. IRIB and Defa Press said Araghchi held sideline meetings with Russia's Lavrov, India's Ajit Doval and Thailand's foreign minister, telling the session there is no military solution regarding Iran.

threads.label: UK sanctions list and US damage claims
threads.summary: The FCDO updated its Iran list of designations and sanctions notices. The Jerusalem Post quoted Admiral Brad Cooper saying Iran's defence industry has been set back by 90%, while IRIB cited CNN reporting that US intelligence assessments contradict administration claims and that Iran has preserved significant drone and coastal missile capabilities.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and Yemen
threads.summary: The Times of Israel reported three civilians injured in a Hezbollah attack on northern Israel ahead of a third round of Israel-Lebanon talks, and IDF assessments that the Hezbollah drone threat is serious but overstated. The Jerusalem Post said Beirut wrote to the UN in late April complaining of unauthorised Iranian activities on Lebanese territory, and that the Yemeni government and Houthis will exchange over 1,600 prisoners.

threads.label: 40-day commemoration and war framing
threads.summary: Defa Press covered the 40-day commemoration of armed forces commander Seyyed Abdolrahim Mousavi at the Abdolazim shrine, and reported President Pezeshkian's message that Iranians showed unity through the '40-day war'. Khamenei's office published donation channels for war-affected citizens, and Bagheri told an SCO meeting that Ali Larijani had been assassinated during the conflict.

threads.label: Iran domestic economy and protests
threads.summary: IRIB reported cabinet measures cutting customs duty on medicine and infant formula to 1%, debt-repayment extensions for war-damaged production units, and a Tehran police seizure of 990 tonnes of hoarded essential goods valued at around 400 billion tomans. Iran International reported rents driving Iranians back into shared housing, and detailed deliberate Najafabad power cuts on 8-9 January used to cover lethal force, including the killing of 18-year-old Parham Mehrabi in Mashhad.

threads.label: FIFA, World Cup and Iran team
threads.summary: IRIB reported foreign ministry legal deputy Gharibabadi warning FIFA against any obstruction of Iran's national team participation in the World Cup. The Jerusalem Post said thousands attended a departure rally for the team in Tehran's Enqelab Square amid concerns about entry into the United States.
